title: Participant
description: A typed participant: a human:, agent:, or system: address plus display metadata. The address prefix and 'kind' must agree (PROTO-FR-02). Participants are the only identity carried in the message envelope; HumanGateway does not perform consumer role-checks (SP-09). Identity-model links (AUTH-FR-01, AUTH-FR-02): human participants may carry a userId referencing a local Edge User record (user.schema.json); system participants may carry a gatewayId referencing an Edge Gateway identity record (gateway.schema.json).

address.description: Typed address. Must start with the prefix matching 'kind'.

kind.description: Participant kind. Must match the address prefix.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name, cached from the last known metadata.

userId.description: Optional local user identifier for human participants — references user.schema.json#/id (the local Edge user account, AUTH-FR-02). Not used for authorisation by HumanGateway (SP-09).

gatewayId.description: Optional Edge Gateway identity when this system participant represents a gateway — references gateway.schema.json#/gatewayId (AUTH-FR-01). When present, it must equal the gatewayId of the sync batch carrying the message.

anyOf.description: System participant (e.g. a gateway, relay, or service account).
